title: Who got hired: readers, politics, and audiences hating music racks
summary: Hiring turned on need and ability to read, though crowds disliked bands seen with sheet music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
